scripts.build:veilkit: OUT=$PWD/vendor/veilkit && cd ${VEILKIT_DIR:-../../veilkit}/crates/veilkit-wasm && CARGO_TARGET_WASM32_UNKNOWN_UNKNOWN_RUSTFLAGS="-C panic=abort -C opt-level=z --remap-path-prefix=${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}=/cargo --remap-path-prefix=$HOME=/home --remap-path-prefix=$(cd ../.. && pwd)=/veilkit" wasm-pack build --release --target web --out-dir "$OUT" --out-name veilkit && rm -f "$OUT/.gitignore" && if strings "$OUT/veilkit_bg.wasm" | grep -q "$HOME"; then echo 'vendored wasm embeds a home path' >&2; exit 1; fi
